title: 2025 AI Game Dev Landscape
author: redditbin
selftext:
Put together a landscape of companies working on various areas of AI in game development. Curious if there are any others I should add!  

https://preview.redd.it/t0etyuzvsx8f1.png?width=3297&format=png&auto=webp&s=fc0eadb289e54bb9a6f70779d392d1cd08a79bdc

(Full disclosure: I work at Coplay)

comments.author: Katwazere
comments.body:
Thanks. There's a lot of stuff that goes under the radar so it will be interesting to look them up

Also I've spoken to one of the benzi guys here as well so you got some information competition

replies.body: Might have been me? Either way I am with Bezi and you will see a lot of me around here.

replies.body: Yes, it is you. I was the one asking about Unreal

replies.body: I remember that.  Nice to bump into you again.

replies.author: ai_art_is_art
replies.body: Are you guys working for VC firms? If not, you should be.

comments.author: Puzzleheaded_Math_55
comments.body: I want to build an educational platform, with creator mode enabled, kids can make their own science games. Is it possible to leverage/integrate any from your list?

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body:
What did you think of building it with? You could go pure Claude 4 with cline, or try bolt.new

If using a unity, coplay would be a huge boost
